transcript.question: How has remote work changed your days?
transcript.answer: I love it. No commute, I have two extra hours every day and I see my kids much more.

transcript.question: What works best for you?
transcript.answer: The flexibility. I plan deep work in the morning and I'm far more productive than in the office.

transcript.question: Looking ahead, what would you keep?
transcript.answer: All of it honestly, I would never go back. It improved my family life a lot.

transcript.question: What tools do you use daily?
transcript.answer: Too many. Slack, Jira, Notion, email. It's overwhelming and I hate it.

transcript.question: How do they affect your focus?
transcript.answer: Constant notifications. I can't finish anything, I'm frustrated and stressed every day.

transcript.question: What would you change?
transcript.answer: Honestly I'd delete half of them. They make my job worse, not better.

transcript.question: How do you use AI at work?
transcript.answer: It drafts my emails and summaries, saves me a lot of time.

transcript.question: Any concerns?
transcript.answer: Yes, I worry it could replace my job, and it makes mistakes I have to catch.

transcript.question: How do you see the future?
transcript.answer: Useful but I don't fully trust it. Excited and nervous at the same time.

transcript.question: What are you learning right now?
When do you study?
transcript.answer: Usually in the evening, about an hour, three times a week.

transcript.question: What's next?
transcript.answer: Finish the course, then maybe a data analysis module.

transcript.question: How are team meetings remotely?
transcript.answer: Oh great, another eight video calls a day, just what everyone dreams of.

transcript.question: How connected do you feel to your team?
transcript.answer: Super connected to my cat. I haven't really talked to a colleague in weeks, it's lonely.

transcript.question: What would help?
transcript.answer: Fewer calls and maybe actually meeting people sometimes.

transcript.question: What keeps you going?
transcript.answer: The lab team, they are good.
